We are about pain relief, FAST!

Welcome to the official YouTube channel for Select Spine & Sports Medicine. We are a rehab and sports based chiropractic practice, open since 2012 located in Friendswood, TX. Our channel is specifically designed for health-conscious folks who want to feel better faster.  

We regularly post a variety of self help tutorial videos WHERE YOU CAN LEARN to fix yourself!  We also post patient treatment videos including the spinal manipulation videos, where you might hear the back or neck cracking sound.  We certainly love it and hope you do to!  

SUBSCRIBE NOW and turn NOTIFICATIONS ON so you don't miss the newest and best content!

We can be reached at:
Select Spine & Sports Medicine
11305 W Parkwood Ave. Ste 101
Friendswood, TX 77546
P: 281-993-2122

Web: https://www.ChiropractorFriendswood.com
FB: https://www.facebook.com/SelectSpineAndSportsMedicine/
IG: https://www.instagram.com/select_spine_and_sports/
